description: Send a reply to the CUSTOMER on an Intercom conversation, from the brand's inbox as the teammate who owns the connection. This reaches a real customer and cannot be unsent. Read the conversation first (read_intercom_conversation), draft the reply in the brand's voice, show the user the exact words, and send only when they ask: call with confirm:true. Without confirm it sends nothing and returns the preview. The result is read back from the conversation Intercom returns. Plain text; blank lines become paragraphs. Never leave a placeholder such as [Your name] or [Order number] in it: Intercom already shows the customer which teammate replied, so sign with the brand's name or leave it unsigned, and ask the user for any fact you do not have. Free. Needs Intercom connected (Settings > Connectors > Intercom, or connect_connector).

confirm.description: true only after the user approved this exact reply

message.description: the exact reply the customer will read, with no [placeholders]

name: reply_to_intercom_conversation
title: Reply to an Intercom customer
